title: Add WebGL2Executor and demo.js tests
userRequest:
## Summary

The cycle that built plan `3d-rendering-and-animation-simbiguity-anim-simbiguity-render-a-webgl2-executor-and-the-3d-circuit-view` closed with this follow-up open on a file it changed:

Re-read the completed plan and the current code before planning: the rest of that plan has shipped.
description:
Added unit tests for WebGL2Executor's GL calls and demo.js's history.replaceState hash write. Mocked global objects directly in the test files since Node was used as the test runner.

Scope verdict: No deliverables delivered this cycle. Deferred deliverables: Circuit simulation, Physics simulation, Market simulation, Animation support, From-scratch 3D rendering via a WebGL2 renderer, Hand-written WASM interface exposing the crates to the browser, and Static HTML demos embedding the simulations (all deferred to later roadmap plan).
